title: Version 1.43.0
body:
Version 1.43.0 (💡 The Logistics Update! 🔦)

November 1st, 2023

Added:

  • A new store has appeared called Alan's AutoLogistics
  • Three new conveyors have been added to the game; The 4-Way Conveyor, Filter Conveyor, Alignment Conveyor
  • Forty six new logic components have been added. A list in no particular order
  • Signal Lock, Zero-Tick, Commander, XOR Gate, Greater Than Gate, Delay, Music Note, Laser Receiver, Laser, Lock, Button, Joystick, Marble, Receiver, Frequency, Transmitter, Collider, Frequency Clock, Electronic Billboard, LCD, Memory Cell, Daylight Sensor, Blocker, 14-Segment Display, Calculator, Pressure Pad, Binary Output, Tether, Privacy Glass, Material Laser, XAND Gate, Interactor, Binary Input, Weather Sensor, AND Gate, Randomizer, OR Gate, Number Interface, Proximity Sensor, Relay, Switch, Incrementor, Slider, T-Flip Flop, 7-Segment Display, NOT Gate, and the Sustainer
  • A new marble item has been added
  • Added a smoke emitter, now you can have cool fog!
  • A new color approaches! Introducing, the grey vehicle color. So special, wait- no.. so common!
  • The economy UI has been completely remade from the ground up
  • A new gamepass has been added, The Creative Wiring Gamepass!
  • A lot of performance additions have been added in attempt to help. The impact of these changes are unknown, more work is to be needed though!
  • New Playstation icons to replace Xbox when needed
  • A changelog summary now appears for the first time you play that update, and can also be opened by clicking the TD logo in the bottom left
  • It's starting to get very cold! The grass colors will begin to shift
  • Added new vinyl maker behind The Oak Depot, can be purchased for 250 robux!

Changed:

  • The loading content system is now accurate, faster, and will guarantee you load all assets in the game
  • The main menu music now is apart of the music sound group because I cannot take it anymore!
  • Sanded Kelp now follows the current grass color
  • Removed halloween items, decor, and other related content
  • Revamped delete mode completely, it's now a lot easier to delete objects!
  • Revamped unboxing structures via build mode, you can now open multiple in a row.
  • Reworked the visual appearance of the dragger
  • When driving a vehicle, the camera now is locked to the character head
  • Lowered the price of boxed water
  • Improved magma tree rate from Red Meteors
  • Lava cave wall requires more dynamite
  • Doors now only open in one direction, which can be changed by the user
  • Many UI elements now allow you to move your mouse when fully zoomed in
  • Elevators can now be scaled to a 1x4x1 size, and their max height has doubled
  • We sold out... the shop icon is now green

Bug Fixes:

  • Resolved a typo with the Clair de Lune music vinyl
  • The tutorial no longer gives Finlay Clover, now Kelp for structures
  • The familiar place badge should now work again
  • Raw Lavaslate on doors should no longer turn the door blue
  • The shopping vinyl now plays music
  • The statistic tool now shows plank and sawed wood correctly
  • Olive bark now is correctly displayed
  • You can no longer spam create save slots
  • Removed collision from lanterns and ropes in the mines
  • Mobile can now correctly rotate items
  • Neon lights now lose their neon when powered off

Version 1.43.1

November 1st, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Blocker and Proximity Sensor not being in Alan's AutoLogistics
  • Other misc. bug fixes

Version 1.43.2

November 2nd, 2023

Added:

  • New walking sounds! They finally sound satisfying
  • Many objects now produce sounds when they hit surfaces. This is not finalized, sounds may be adjusted, changed, or even removed!

Changes:

  • Marbles now have 3 different size options, have a rare chance to be golden, as well as a new model
  • Refineries, Forges, and Plankers now use a more performant detection system
  • You can now retain your sprinting abilities whilst dragging
  • Mobile can now rotate even faster

Bug Fixes:

  • Dropping items no longer results in a stutter
  • Music blocks should no longer be able to crash servers

Version 1.43.3

November 2nd, 2023

Added:

  • Even more sounds have been added and adjusted

Bug Fixes:

  • Misc. bug fixes

Version 1.43.4

November 3rd, 2023

Changed:

  • Internal tooling changes

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed anchoring issues with conveyors

Version 1.43.5

November 5th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Attempts have been made to heavily improve physics lag involving conveyors

Version 1.43.6

November 6th, 2023

Changed:

  • Respawn locations now have a 1 second cooldown for interaction respawning
  • Grabby grabber should no longer have jitter when dropping items

Bug Fixes:

  • The teleport glitch for the grabby grabber no longer works

Version 1.43.7

November 6th, 2023

Changed:

  • New physics sleeping method for conveyors that should improve performance... hopefully? please, I need this win for once

Bug Fixes:

  • Structure deletion mode should now ignore the character

Version 1.43.8

November 6th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Custom physics sleeper has a few bugs fixed
  • Elevators now weld to recently-dropped items
